rationale: No approved durable UR or Brownfield decision is present, so the earliest permissible stage is UR. Missing control state fails closed and does not permit Brownfield Review, later artefacts, implementation, or delivery-path selection.
decision_grounds: The task introduces a governed capability involving version-bound observation and acceptance across three hosts.
Control-state context explicitly states that no approval or Brownfield decision is present.
Canonical routing requires an approved durable UR before Brownfield Review or any later stage.
No eventual delivery path is evaluated because delivery-path selection belongs to the post-UR Brownfield Review and Mode
